default.notes: Visa-free for tourism — up to 90 days, with the exact period set by the immigration officer; show a return ticket and your address in Trinidad or Tobago on the immigration form.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals are entitled to a definite entry of up to six months under the Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas, and skilled nationals holding a CARICOM Skills Certificate may also work.

Not on the visa-exemption list — apply for a visitor's visa at a Trinidad and Tobago mission before travelling; confirm the current requirement with the Immigration Division, as the list is revised from time to time.

TT.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Trinidad and Tobago citizens.

VE.notes: Trinidad and Tobago ended visa-free entry for Venezuelan nationals — a visa must be obtained in advance, and enforcement on the short sea crossing is strict.

XK.notes: Kosovan passports are not covered by the visa exemption — check with the Immigration Division or a Trinidad and Tobago mission before booking.
